A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

biochar is a very heterogeneous group of materials that have different effects on soil biotic communities, and that it is important to consider the effects of biochars in the context of their physico-chemical properties and the soil environment in which they are applied.
the use of biochar in soils is not without risks, but that the benefits of biochar use outweigh the risks.

we need to understand the mechanisms through which soil biota are affected by biochar.
